svg.title: P02 | First-line PFS gains, sequencing needs evidence

ns2:Work.dc:title: P02 | First-line PFS gains, sequencing needs evidence
ns2:Work.dc:description: Three separate within-trial panels from ADC-20261007-R1 F05. Bars show median PFS in months. HR and 95% CI appear as text only. Dates are FDA announcement dates, not trial data cutoffs. Pilot ADC-20261007-R1-VISUAL-PILOT2-1.0; research as of 2026-10-07.
